      private function qolSettingsClick(param1:MouseEvent) : void
      {
         var action:String = Sprite(param1.currentTarget).name;
         if(action == "speed")
         {
            Level.qolSpeed = Level.qolSpeed == 1 ? 3 : 1;
         }
         else if(action == "cash")
         {
            this.updateCash(100);
         }
         else if(action == "hero_minus")
         {
            Level.qolHeroCount = Math.max(0,Level.qolHeroCount - 1);
            this.qolApplyHeroCount();
         }
         else if(action == "hero_plus")
         {
            Level.qolHeroCount = Math.min(7,Level.qolHeroCount + 1);
            this.qolApplyHeroCount();
         }
         else if(action == "all_waves")
         {
            this.qolSendAllWaves();
         }
         else if(action == "page_enemy")
         {
            this.qolSettingsPage = 1;
         }
         else if(action == "page_main")
         {
            this.qolSettingsPage = 0;
         }
         else if(action == "enemy_prev")
         {
            this.qolEnemyIndex = (this.qolEnemyIndex + this.qolEnemies.length - 1) % this.qolEnemies.length;
         }
         else if(action == "enemy_next")
         {
            this.qolEnemyIndex = (this.qolEnemyIndex + 1) % this.qolEnemies.length;
         }
         else if(action == "count_minus")
         {
            this.qolEnemyCount = Math.max(1,this.qolEnemyCount - 5);
         }
         else if(action == "count_plus")
         {
            this.qolEnemyCount = Math.min(200,this.qolEnemyCount + 5);
         }
         else if(action == "path_prev")
         {
            this.qolEnemyPath = Math.max(0,this.qolEnemyPath - 1);
         }
         else if(action == "path_next")
         {
            this.qolEnemyPath = Math.min(Math.max(0,this.§_-V8§.length - 1),this.qolEnemyPath + 1);
         }
         else if(action == "send_custom")
         {
            this.qolSendCustomRound();
         }
         else if(action == "hide")
         {
            this.qolHideSettings();
            return;
         }
         this.qolRenderSettings();
      }

      private function qolSpawnExtraHeroes() : void
      {
         var roster:Array = ["alric","mirage","captain","cronan","shatra","grawl","nivus","dierdre","ashbite"];
         var primary:String = this.game.gameHeroData.selectedHero.name;
         var i:int = 0;
         for each(var heroName in roster)
         {
            if(heroName != primary)
            {
               if(i >= Level.qolHeroCount - 1)
               {
                  break;
               }
               var h:§dynamic const class§ = this.qolMakeHero(heroName,i + 1);
               if(h != null)

                  this.entities.addChild(h);
                  this.qolExtraHeroes.push(h);
                  i++;
               }
            }
         }
      }
      
      private function qolApplyHeroCount() : void
      {
         var desired:int = int(Level.qolHeroCount);
         var current:int = (this.hero != null && this.hero.parent != null ? 1 : 0) + this.qolExtraHeroes.length;
         while(current > desired && this.qolExtraHeroes.length > 0)
         {
            var oldHero:§dynamic const class§ = this.qolExtraHeroes.pop();
            if(oldHero != null && oldHero.parent != null)
            {
               oldHero.parent.removeChild(oldHero);
            }
            current--;
         }
         if(desired == 0 && this.hero != null && this.hero.parent != null)
         {
            this.hero.parent.removeChild(this.hero);
            current = 0;
         }
         if(desired > 0 && (this.hero == null || this.hero.parent == null))
         {
            this.switchHeroes();
            if(this.hero != null && this.hero.parent == null)
            {
               this.entities.addChild(this.hero);
            }
            current = 1 + this.qolExtraHeroes.length;
         }
         if(current < desired)
         {
            while(this.qolExtraHeroes.length > 0)
            {
               var existing:§dynamic const class§ = this.qolExtraHeroes.pop();
               if(existing != null && existing.parent != null)
               {
                  existing.parent.removeChild(existing);
               }
            }
            this.qolSpawnExtraHeroes();
         }
      }

      override public function onStart() : Boolean
      {
         var _loc1_:§_-5u§ = null;
         if(this.mode == §_-Mm§.MODE_IRON && !this.deadthRaidersAdded)
         {
            this.deadthRaidersAdded = true;
            for each(_loc1_ in this.towers)
            {
               if(getQualifiedClassName(_loc1_) == "TowerMageNecromancer")
               {
                  (_loc1_ as TowerMageNecromancer).spawnDeathRider();
                  (_loc1_ as TowerMageNecromancer).deathRiderCurrentLevel = 1;
               }
            }
         }
         return super.onStart();
      }
      
      override protected function hasEnemies() : Boolean
      {
         var _loc1_:int = 0;
         var _loc2_:Enemy = null;
         if(this.mode != §_-Mm§.MODE_CAMPAIGN)
         {
            return super.hasEnemies();
         }
         for each(_loc2_ in this.enemies)
         {
            if(getQualifiedClassName(_loc2_) != "EnemyGorillaBoss")
            {
               _loc1_++;

      public function §_-oq§(param1:Object) : Number
      {
         var total:Number = 0;
         var i:int = 0;
         var j:int = 0;
         while(i < 5)
         {
            j = int(param1.skillArray[i].level);
            while(j < 3)
            {
               total += param1.skillArray[i].cost[j];
               j++;
            }
            i++;
         }
         return total;
      }
      
      public function calculateTotalCost(param1:Object) : Number
      {
         var _loc4_:int = 0;
         var _loc2_:Number = 0;
         var _loc3_:int = 0;
         while(_loc3_ < 5)
         {
            if(param1.skillArray[_loc3_].level > 0)
            {
               _loc4_ = 0;
               while(_loc4_ < param1.skillArray[_loc3_].level)
               {
                  _loc2_ += param1.skillArray[_loc3_].cost[_loc4_];
                  _loc4_++;
               }
            }
            _loc3_++;
         }
         return _loc2_;
      }
